thread:
marta: Heads-up — onboarding quickstart users hitting `Cannot find module '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'` after 2.1.0 publish. Quickpack shows only .mjs artifacts and no types.

kevin: Can you paste the tarball file list?

marta: `npm pack` output from registry: 
``npackage/README.md
package/dist/edge/main.mjs
package/dist/edge/main.mjs.map
package/package.json
```
No `dist/node` and no `dist/types`.

pkg-bot: Packaging job: https://ci.example.com/jobs/7701. Publish step used `files: ["dist/**","README.md"]` but `.npmignore` contains `dist/node/*` (legacy). DTS pipeline writes to `dist/_dts` and was excluded by files[].

ellen: Short-term mitigation: republish patch that includes node CJS bundle and typings under `dist/types`. Long-term: standardize layout to `dist/node`, `dist/edge`, `dist/types` and make `exports` explicit ("require" -> "./dist/node/main.cjs", "import" -> "./dist/edge/main.mjs").

kevin: Also saw Sentry frames referring to `main.cjs.map` even though we shipped `.mjs`. Looks like sourcemap names were generated for cjs in some chunks by the node build config but not included. We should ensure sourcemap targets match published filenames.

marta: Action items: 1) Rebuild with tsup formats ["cjs","esm"] for node+edge; 2) have dts output to `dist/types`; 3) fix `files` or `.npmignore` to include node/types; 4) add a CI pack-check: `npm pack && tar -tf` + run node require smoke test, esm import smoke test, and `tsc --noEmit`.

support: Please ping when the patch is live so we can respond to open tickets. Also add a short note in quickstart recommending `import` for Node >=14 and include a `require()` fallback for older setups.

kevin: Republished 2.1.1-rc with correct artifacts. `npm pack` now shows: 
``npackage/dist/node/main.cjs
package/dist/node/main.cjs.map
package/dist/edge/main.mjs
package/dist/edge/main.mjs.map
package/dist/types/main.d.ts
package/package.json
```
Smoke tests: node require/import ✓, ESM import ✓, tsc typecheck ✓.

marta: Great. Filing RFC to lock the publish layout and add the pack-check CI step. Will also add release checklist item: "verify artifacts (.cjs, .mjs, .d.ts), exports mapping, and sourcemap paths."

support: Notified customers and updated KB. Closing thread after RFC lands.
